cards.text: Moses just met God at a burning bush, and his orders are clear: Egypt (Exodus 3:2-10). So first he goes back to his father-in-law Jethro, the priest of Midian (Exodus 3:1). He asks him, “Please let me return to my brothers in Egypt to see if they are still alive.”

cards.question: Jethro tells Moses to stay in Midian a little while longer.

cards.text: Now here's a detail. Back in Midian, the LORD had already told Moses it was safe to go back, and friend, Moses did NOT leave Egypt on good terms (Exodus 2:15).

cards.question: Why does the LORD say it's safe for Moses to go back to Egypt?

answers.text: The men who wanted to kill him are dead
Pharaoh has forgiven what he did years ago
The Israelites have promised to hide him

cards.text: So Moses puts his wife and sons on ONE donkey and heads for Egypt, the staff of God in his hand. I spent years crammed in the back of a junk drawer, and even I'm looking at that donkey saying, “That's tight.”
Then the LORD gives Moses his instructions for when he gets back to Egypt and stands before Pharaoh.

cards.question: When Moses stands before Pharaoh, what does the LORD tell him to do?

answers.text: Perform all the wonders he was given
Offer a sacrifice right in front of him
Bow down and ask for mercy

cards.question: The LORD tells Moses that once Pharaoh sees the wonders, he'll let the people go right away.

cards.text: The LORD says it plainly: He will harden Pharaoh's heart so that he will not let the people go. Then He gives Moses a message for Pharaoh, and it begins with Israel, His firstborn son.

cards.question: The LORD's message says He told Pharaoh to let His son Israel go. For what reason?

answers.text: So he can rest from his work
So he can farm his own fields

cards.text: The message goes on: Pharaoh has refused to let God's son go. Moses has to say this to PHARAOH, friend, and I get the shakes just telling a baker their cookies came out a little flat!

cards.question: Because Pharaoh refuses, the LORD says He will kill Pharaoh's ___ son.

cards.text: Then, at a lodging place along the way, something shocking happens. The LORD meets Moses and is about to kill him.

cards.question: Moses' life is on the line at that lodging place. Who steps in?

cards.text: Zipporah takes a flint knife, cuts off her son's foreskin and touches it to Moses' feet. She says, “Surely you are a bridegroom of blood to me,” and she's referring to the circumcision.

cards.question: After Zipporah acts, the LORD lets Moses alone.

cards.text: Meanwhile, the LORD had told Aaron, Moses' brother (Exodus 4:14), “Go and meet Moses in the wilderness.” So Aaron heads into the wilderness to find one man, and friend, I can't even find my rolling pin in my OWN bakery.

cards.question: Where do Aaron and Moses finally meet up?

answers.text: On the banks of the Nile

cards.text: Aaron sees his brother and kisses him. My cookie cutter kids got packed up and carried off before I could say goodbye, so friend, this one gets me right in the dough.

cards.question: Moses keeps the signs to himself and lets Aaron find out at the big meeting.

cards.text: Then Moses and Aaron gather all the elders of the Israelites. You know that moment after you call a meeting, when everybody sits down, gets quiet and looks right at YOU?

cards.question: With the elders gathered, who relays everything the LORD said to Moses?
While Aaron does the talking, Moses performs the ___ before the people.
After hearing the LORD's words and seeing the signs, the people believe.
When the people hear that the LORD has attended to the Israelites and seen their affliction, what do they do?

cards.text: Hold that thought, friend, and keep the oven warm, because this story is FAR from finished.
